clips.title: The story
paras: Across Hillsbrad and Alterac, Mountain Lion Blood draws Apothecary Lydon’s interest. In Tarren Mill, Lydon seeks fresh blood to make the Royal Apothecary Society’s dreaded Elixir of Pain.

Mountain lions prowl the highlands and foothills of Hillsbrad and Alterac. Hunters prize their pelts and claws, while the Forsaken of the Royal Apothecary Society seek the blood in their veins. Apothecary Lydon in Tarren Mill believes fresh mountain lion blood can form the base of a potent brew meant to bring misery to the living.

Apothecary Lydon’s experiments in Tarren Mill support the Royal Apothecary Society’s work to perfect the Forsaken’s New Plague. Lydon gathers blood from vigorous wild beasts to refine a concoction called the Elixir of Pain, testing how local organic compounds can be turned against the enemies of the Dark Lady.
